events.summary: Slonk is struck by lightning seventy times while developing and perfecting his idea.
events.quote: Slonk was struck by lightning twenty-seven times before he got the idea.

events.summary: Amin faces his final trial for a place among the honored dead.
events.quote: Only one final trial stood between Amin and his place among the honored dead.

events.summary: Gisela corners a murderous demon among villagers' graves and raises her sword.
events.quote: Gisela cornered the murderous demon among the graves of the dead villagers.

events.summary: Baral's trap for Chandra is foiled by the arrival of a huge leonin with a twin-headed axe.
events.quote: When Baral constructed his trap for Chandra, he did not account for the arrival of an enormous leonin wielding a twin-headed axe.

events.summary: Michiko leaves home, vowing not to return until she can restore her father and Kamigawa's peace.
events.quote: Tell him I'm safe, but I won't come home until I find out how to bring him back to his senses, and Kamigawa is again at peace.

events.summary: Asha leaves Bant after ensuring its protection.
events.quote: When Asha left Bant, she ensured that the world would have protection and order in her absence.

events.summary: Vraska tries to prevent death for the first time.
events.quote: For the first time in her life, Vraska tried to prevent death.

events.summary: Thraben's army is recalled, leaving outlying villages to fend for themselves.
events.quote: With Thraben's army recalled to its city walls, outlying villages were left to fend for themselves.

events.summary: Kalitas returns to mindless servitude beneath the Eldrazi; Drana's vampires refuse.
events.quote: Kalitas may have returned to mindless servitude beneath the Eldrazi, but we say never again.

events.summary: The Hekma is destroyed and the wandering dead lay waste to Naktamun.
events.quote: With the Hekma destroyed, the wandering dead that sought entrance to Naktamun had free rein to lay waste to the city.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis, trapped on Ravnica, commits random acts of torment.
events.quote: Trapped on Ravnica with no affection for either side, Ob Nixilis sought gratification in random acts of torment.

events.summary: Odric realizes Skirsdag infiltrators have compromised the church.
events.quote: I can no longer stand by as these Skirsdag infiltrators rot the church from within.

events.summary: Kastinne follows her children's tormentors into caves below Stensia.
events.quote: Vowing to free the souls of her children, Kastinne followed the tormentors into the ghastly network of caves below Stensia.

events.summary: Belzenlok transforms Yar-Kul into a maggot; the frog that ate it becomes Yargle.
events.quote: When Belzenlok's lieutenant Yar-Kul grew too ambitious, the Demonlord transformed him into a maggot.

events.summary: Aboard the Heart of Kiran, Chandra answers Dovin Baan's sabotage explosively.
events.quote: In the hold of the *Heart of Kiran*, Chandra answered Dovin Baan's sabotage with an explosive retort.

events.summary: Sea Gate is retaken by all who could fight.
events.quote: Everyone who could still lift a weapon had a part in retaking Sea Gate.

events.summary: Syr Ameril faces a blaze of dragonfire, thinking of home in her last thoughts.
events.quote: As the blaze raced toward her, Syr Ameril closed her eyes and pictured Castle Ardenvale so her last thoughts would be of home.

events.summary: Calix follows Elspeth to their destined confrontation.
events.quote: Calix was patient, steadily following Elspeth until their destined confrontation.

events.summary: Ugin tells Jace the Eldrazi can be imprisoned by hedrons; Jace is skeptical.
events.quote: "And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.

events.summary: Kunh Mei speaks last words before throwing a vial of dragonfire.
events.quote: I just need to make sure to throw it far enough.
